title: A 'Super' El Niño: Why Global Weather is Reaching Dangerous New Levels
subtitle: From shipping delays in Panama to extreme heat records, the world faces the strongest weather event in over a century.

summary.en: A powerful weather pattern called El Niño is currently forming in the Pacific Ocean. Experts at the UK Met Office warn it could be the strongest event in over a century. This phenomenon is causing severe droughts and changing rainfall patterns across the globe. As a result, the Panama Canal has already limited ship traffic due to low water levels. Scientists expect this event to make 2027 one of the hottest years on record.
summary.zh: 一種稱為聖嬰現象的強大天氣型態目前正在太平洋形成。英國氣象局的專家警告，這可能是超過一個世紀以來最強烈的事件。此現象正導致全球出現嚴重乾旱並改變降雨型態。受此影響，巴拿馬運河已因水位下降而限制船隻通行。科學家預計，此事件將使二〇二七年成為有紀錄以來最熱的年份之一。

paragraphs.en: A powerful and rare weather event is currently developing over the Pacific Ocean, and experts are warning that it could be the strongest one in living memory. Known as El Niño, this natural phenomenon is expected to push global temperatures to record-breaking levels. According to the UK Met Office, this event is so intense that it is likely to make 2027 the hottest year ever recorded. Prof Adam Scaife, the head of long-range forecasting at the Met Office, noted that he has never seen such an intense signal in his professional career.
paragraphs.zh: 一個強大且罕見的氣象事件目前正在太平洋上空形成，專家警告這可能是人類記憶中最劇烈的一次。這種被稱為「聖嬰現象 (El Niño)」的自然現象，預計將把全球氣溫推向破紀錄的水準。根據英國氣象局 (UK Met Office) 的說法，此事件強度之高，極可能使二〇二七年成為有紀錄以來最熱的一年。英國氣象局長期預報部門主管亞當·斯凱夫 (Adam Scaife) 教授指出，他在職業生涯中從未見過如此強烈的訊號。

paragraphs.en: El Niño is a natural cycle that happens every two to seven years. Usually, trade winds blow warm water from east to west across the Pacific. During an El Niño, these winds weaken or even change direction, allowing warm water to spread eastward. This process releases heat into the atmosphere, which changes weather patterns around the world. While El Niño is a natural event, scientists are concerned because it is happening in a world that is already warming due to human activity. Dr. Zeke Hausfather, a climate scientist at Berkeley Earth, stated that the ongoing development of this event gives experts high confidence that it will set new records.
paragraphs.zh: 聖嬰現象是一種每兩到七年發生一次的自然週期。通常，信風會將溫暖的海水從太平洋東側吹向西側。在聖嬰現象期間，這些風力會減弱甚至改變方向，導致溫暖海水向東擴散。此過程會將熱量釋放到大氣中，進而改變全球的天氣型態。雖然聖嬰現象屬於自然事件，但科學家感到擔憂，因為它發生在一個因人類活動而持續暖化的世界中。柏克萊地球 (Berkeley Earth) 的氣候科學家澤克·豪斯法瑟 (Zeke Hausfather) 博士表示，該事件持續發展，讓專家們高度確信它將創下新的紀錄。

paragraphs.en: The impact of this weather pattern is already being felt in many parts of the world. In Central America, the Panama Canal Authority announced that it will limit the number of ships allowed to pass through the waterway. This is because the region is facing a severe drought, which has lowered the water levels in the lakes that feed the canal. The canal is a vital route for global trade, and these new restrictions are a direct result of the lack of rainfall caused by the shifting climate conditions. According to the canal operator, rainfall between May and August was significantly lower than the historical average.
paragraphs.zh: 這種天氣型態的影響已在世界許多地方顯現。在中美洲，巴拿馬運河管理局 (Panama Canal Authority) 宣布將限制允許通過該水道的船隻數量。這是因為該地區正面臨嚴重乾旱，導致供給運河的湖泊水位下降。運河是全球貿易的重要航線，這些新限制是氣候條件改變導致降雨不足的直接後果。根據運河營運商的說法，五月至八月間的降雨量顯著低於歷史平均值。

paragraphs.en: Other regions are also preparing for difficult conditions. The Met Office reports that the UK is likely to experience a wet and stormy autumn. Meanwhile, other parts of the world, such as South America and the west Pacific, are expected to face very severe droughts. The United Nations has warned that the conditions created by this El Niño could put as many as 50 million people at risk of hunger by the end of next year. Prof Hayley Fowler from Newcastle University noted that the scale of this event could reach levels similar to the 1877-78 period, which caused widespread famine and significant loss of life.
paragraphs.zh: 其他地區也正為艱困的狀況做準備。英國氣象局報告稱，英國今年秋季可能會經歷潮濕且多風暴的天氣。同時，南美洲和西太平洋等世界其他地區，預計將面臨極為嚴重的乾旱。聯合國已發出警告，稱聖嬰現象造成的狀況可能導致明年年底前多達五千萬人面臨飢餓風險。紐卡索大學 (Newcastle University) 的海莉·福勒 (Hayley Fowler) 教授指出，此次事件的規模可能達到一八七七至一八七八年間的水準，當時曾造成廣泛的饑荒與重大的生命損失。

paragraphs.en: There is a debate among scientists regarding the relationship between climate change and El Niño. The World Meteorological Organisation states there is no clear evidence that climate change makes these events happen more often or makes them stronger. However, research from the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) suggests that the intensity of these events may have increased since 1950. Even if climate change does not directly cause El Niño, experts agree that the extra heat it brings can make the effects of a warming world feel much worse.
paragraphs.zh: 科學界對於氣候變遷與聖嬰現象之間的關係存在爭論。世界氣象組織 (World Meteorological Organisation) 表示，目前沒有明確證據顯示氣候變遷會導致此類事件發生得更頻繁或更強烈。然而，政府間氣候變遷專門委員會 (IPCC) 的研究顯示，自一九五〇年以來，這些事件的強度可能有所增加。即使氣候變遷並非聖嬰現象的直接成因，專家們也一致認為，它所帶來的額外熱量會讓暖化世界的影響感覺更加惡劣。

paragraphs.en: While the Met Office considers its current forecast to be conservative, other groups suggest the situation could be even more extreme. Some projections indicate that sea surface temperatures in the Pacific could rise by as much as 4C above the long-term average. If this happens, it could be the strongest El Niño in up to 1,000 years. The US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration has also confirmed there is a very high chance of a strong event, with a probability of over 90%.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然英國氣象局認為目前的預測較為保守，但其他團體認為情況可能更為極端。一些預測顯示，太平洋的海面溫度可能比長期平均值高出攝氏四度。如果發生這種情況，這可能是長達一千年來最強烈的聖嬰現象。美國國家海洋暨大氣總署 (US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) 也證實，發生強烈事件的可能性極高，機率超過百分之九十。

paragraphs.en: As the world watches the Pacific, the consequences of this "super" El Niño are becoming clear. From the disruption of international shipping routes to the increased risk of storms and droughts, the event is a reminder of how connected global weather systems are. For many countries, the coming months will be a test of their ability to manage the risks of extreme weather. As the event nears its peak later this year, the global community will be closely monitoring how these changes affect food supplies, energy needs, and the safety of people in the most vulnerable areas.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著全球目光聚焦於太平洋，這場「超級」聖嬰現象的後果正變得清晰。從國際航運路線的中斷，到風暴與乾旱風險的增加，此事件提醒了我們全球天氣系統之間的連結有多緊密。對許多國家而言，未來幾個月將是考驗其管理極端天氣風險能力的時候。隨著該事件在今年稍晚達到高峰，國際社會將密切關注這些變化如何影響糧食供應、能源需求，以及最脆弱地區民眾的安全。

keyTerms.definitionEn: The period of time that can be remembered by people who are still alive.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 在人們有記憶以來；在活人的記憶中。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個固定搭配，容易誤以為是「活著的記憶」。文中：experts are warning that it could be the strongest one in living memory.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To supply something to a larger system or structure.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「餵食」，這裡指水流注入運河。文中：which has lowered the water levels in the lakes that feed the canal.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Cautious and likely to be lower than the actual amount.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 保守的；（估計）偏低的、謹慎的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「保守派」，這裡指預測數字較為謹慎。文中：While the Met Office considers its current forecast to be conservative, other groups suggest the situation could be even more extreme.

previousArticles.title: Europe Faces Growing Threat from Extreme Wildfires and Rising Costs
previousArticles.summaryEn: Europe is currently struggling with severe wildfires caused by extreme heat and long-lasting droughts. These fires have already destroyed thousands of square kilometers of forest and caused billions of euros in damage. Research indicates that the risk of such fires will likely increase in the coming decades. Beyond the environmental impact, extreme weather is also pushing up the cost of living by affecting food and energy prices. Experts suggest that better forest management and urgent climate action are necessary to prevent even worse outcomes in the future.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the primary reason the Panama Canal Authority is restricting ship traffic?

options.A: A change in the trade winds has made the canal route physically dangerous.
options.B: Insufficient rainfall has caused water levels in the feeding lakes to drop.
options.C: The canal is undergoing maintenance to prepare for record-breaking temperatures.
options.D: Global trade demands have decreased significantly due to the current El Niño.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第三段明確指出，巴拿馬運河限制船隻通行是因為該地區面臨嚴重乾旱，導致供給運河的湖泊水位下降，而這些乾旱是氣候條件改變造成的。選項 A 雖然提到了貿易風，但那是 El Niño 的成因，而非運河限行的直接原因。選項 C 文章並未提及維修。選項 D 與事實相反，文章指出運河是貿易的重要路徑，並未提到需求下降。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why are scientists particularly concerned about this specific El Niño event?

options.A: It is the first time in history that an El Niño event has occurred.
options.B: It is expected to last for a duration of seven years.
options.C: It is occurring against the backdrop of a planet already affected by human-induced warming.
options.D: It is predicted to be the final El Niño event before climate change stabilizes.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段，科學家擔憂的原因在於此自然現象發生在一個已經因人類活動而變暖的世界中，這會加劇其影響。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到 El Niño 每二到七年發生一次。選項 B 錯誤，文章說的是發生頻率，並非此次事件持續七年。選項 D 文章中並未提到這是最後一次事件，也沒有提到氣候變遷會穩定下來。

quiz.question: In the phrase 'the Met Office considers its current forecast to be conservative,' what does the word 'conservative' imply?

options.A: The predictions are cautious and likely underestimate the potential severity.
options.B: The forecast is based on traditional, outdated scientific methods.
options.C: The weather experts are politically aligned with traditional viewpoints.
options.D: The data provided is highly unlikely to be accurate or reliable.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在科學預測的語境中，conservative 指的是預測較為「保守」，即傾向於給出較低的估計值，實際情況往往會比預測的更嚴重。選項 B 錯誤，conservative 在此處指預測的「程度」，而非方法的老舊。選項 C 與政治無關。選項 D 錯誤，文章提到其他團體認為情況可能更極端，代表該預測並非不可靠，只是採取了較為謹慎的估計方式。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article?

options.A: El Niño is a man-made weather phenomenon that can be prevented with better policy.
options.B: The Panama Canal is the only major area affected by the upcoming weather changes.
options.C: Scientists are in complete agreement that climate change is the direct cause of El Niño.
options.D: The developing 'super' El Niño poses significant global risks by intensifying the effects of a warming climate.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於探討這次罕見且強大的 El Niño 事件，以及它如何與全球暖化相互作用，對全球糧食、航運及氣候造成嚴重威脅。選項 A 錯誤，文章強調這是自然現象。選項 B 過於狹隘，僅提到局部影響。選項 C 錯誤，文章第五段明確指出科學界對於氣候變遷是否直接導致 El Niño 仍有爭議。
